author: StevieNaeNae
body:
Hello! My name is Alfred_ and I would like to suggest a command in DTM. This command is /monuments and it would tell you who broke which monument(s). This would be helpful because it would tell you the info you need. That's it really.

Thanks, 
Alfred_

It just sounds like a wast of developers time.
